title: Kirby Problem 4.3
exact_target: Do exotic smooth structures exist on positive-definite sums of complex projective planes, small zero-signature connected sums, or K3 sums in the specified spin range, and what are the smallest or largest parameters admitting them?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2879 (KP-4.3). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (editors), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295 (2026), Problem 4.3, p. 193 and following remarks; original author version.
